title: OPSC Geologist 2019 — Paper I (General Studies & Awareness)
description: Official OPSC Geologist 2019 Paper I booklet (T.B.C. GGM-1/2019): 100 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Answer key prepared by Geo Scholars Academy (OPSC did not publish one). No negative marking in the 2019 paper; the current OPSC pattern is +2 / −0.5.
